description: Top gainers and losers by percentage change among TWSE-listed stocks for the previous trading day, plus how many closed limit-up and limit-down. Each row has the code, name, close, change, percentage change and volume. Use it for "top gainers / top losers / which stocks hit the daily limit" instead of sorting dataset.get by price change, which ranks by absolute points and puts high-priced stocks first. Limit-up and limit-down are derived from the previous close and the tick size (the data carries no flag). Listed stocks only (4-digit codes, no ETFs or warrants); OTC (TPEx) is not covered. Source: TWSE OpenAPI; not live. 上市股票前一交易日的漲幅與跌幅排行（依漲跌幅%，不是依漲跌額），以及漲停、跌停家數。問「漲幅榜」「跌幅榜」「今天漲停幾檔」時用這個，不要用 dataset.get 依漲跌排序——那會依點數排，股價高的永遠排前面。漲停與跌停是依前收盤與升降單位推算（資料本身沒有標記）。範圍是上市股票（四碼代號，不含 ETF 與權證），不含上櫃。資料為前一交易日，不是盤中即時；要當下價格請用 quote.realtime。

limit.description: 漲幅與跌幅各取前幾名，預設 10，最多 30。漲停與跌停家數不受這個數字影響，數的是全部個股。
